verdict.rationale: Adyen documents webhooks that fire when cardholders add Adyen-issued cards to Apple Pay/Google Pay and the card data is tokenized, confirming basic wallet tokenization support, but there is no documentation of a push-provisioning API/SDK, the entitlements/certification process, in-wallet card art customization, or manual provisioning as a fallback. missing for 10: push provisioning API/SDK docs, entitlements process documentation, in-wallet card art specs, manual provisioning fallback flow.
